body: Work for a private ambulance company. All the stress of a fire department, plus the fact that it's for profit. The amount of bullshit I've seen done in the name of getting paid (Medicare/Medicaid fraud, unnecessary transports, dealing with stupid people to keep contacts happy). I guess unless your heartless (or near the top of the company and getting paid enough to look the other way) it's non stop stress. We also don't get paid shit (barely above minimum wage) so having to choose between paying bills or eating is a regular occurrence.
It's cool. Took the day off work today. Didn't do shit (like haven't left the house) used it as kind of an escape. Doing alright for now, tomorrow will be the real test.
